liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry repeatedly flubbed the riffs in this song and seemed unfocused all night [22]
- **Don't Ease Me In** (1 review): Reviewer dislikes that this song closes set one while Day Job closes set two [22]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd84-06-23 s1 t01 Alabama Getaway**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd84-06-23 s1 t02 Promised Land**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd84-06-23 s1 t03 Peggy O**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd84-06-23 s1 t04 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd84-06-23 s1 t05 Brown Eyed Women**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd84-06-23 s1 t06 My Brother Esau**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd84-06-23 s1 t07 Big Railroad Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]
- **gd84-06-23 s1 t08 The Music Never Stopped**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [30]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-06-23.140159.sbd.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 151 min; rated 1.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1984-06-23.166999.neumann.u87.akg414.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 21 songs; 150 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd84-06-23.senn.miller.14951.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 149 min; rated 3/5 by 14 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the tape sounds good [18]
- **gd1984-06-23.164771.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 145 min [9]
- **gd84-06-23.naks.willy.14566.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 153 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [15]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this audience recording sounds very poor, as if taped from outside the venue [23]

## Around the show

- Reviewer drove up to Harrisburg with friends; the field was hot and packed [18]
- Lightning bugs drifted around the stage lights and the woods to the left during the show [19]
- City Island was a small island in the Susquehanna; some of the crowd climbed and swung from trees [24]
- Hot, sweaty crowd near the stage passed water, beer and other items forward because of the heat and crowding [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-06-23.140159.sbd.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Cassette -> Reel to Reel -> Dat 16/48 [1]
- **gd1984-06-23.166999.neumann.u87.akg414.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) Neumann U87's + (2) AKG 414's > Rolls MPX42 mixer > Sony D5M [2]. Also: Rob Eaton's recording with Neumann U87 and AKG 414 microphones; Miller's Sennheiser 441 source supplies a crowd/tuning bit and a Drums patch [2]
- **gd84-06-23.senn.miller.14951.sbeok.shnf**: source: Recording Info:(FOB) Senn 441 -> PCM -> Dat [5]
- **gd1984-06-23.164771.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell UDXLII-S) [9]
- **gd84-06-23.naks.willy.14566.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by CDR > EAC > SHN by Willy; source: AUD (Nak 100's)>MC>DAT>CDR [15]
